NOAA NCEI - International Comprehensive Ocean-Atmosphere Data Set (ICOADS)
ICOADS Release 3.0.2 near-real-time daily files (NOAA NCEI), best duplicates only, Pacific regional subset (lon 108E-70W, lat 58.45S-23.90N)

Surface marine observations from Voluntary Observing Ships and other ships in the tropical and South Pacific, from the NOAA NCEI International Comprehensive Ocean-Atmosphere Data Set (ICOADS) Release 3.0.2 near-real-time daily files (from October 2025). Only best duplicates are kept; values outside each variable's valid range are set to missing. Variables keep their ICOADS/IMMA1 short names (see icoads_name and the IMMA1 documentation). station_idx = -1 marks generic or masked IDs (e.g. SHIP). Data are updated hourly; NCEI replaces each preliminary day with an updated file about 19 days later.
ICOADS data are freely available from NOAA NCEI without restriction. Please cite ICOADS (Freeman et al., 2017) and acknowledge NOAA NCEI. [standard]

One row per ICOADS platform (ship, drifting buoy, moored buoy, tide gauge, coastal station) that has reported in the tropical and South Pacific since October 2025: identity, latest position and time, activity in the last 24 h, latest value of the main variables, and registry metadata from OceanOPS and NDBC. Ship call signs are as distributed by ICOADS (masked where operators require it). Observations are in the icoads_nrt_* datasets, linked by station / station_idx.
ICOADS data are freely available from NOAA NCEI without restriction. Please cite ICOADS (Freeman et al., 2017) and acknowledge NOAA NCEI. [standard]
